newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Lebed meets U.S. state dept official.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Lebed meets U.S. state dept official.

text.p: Russian national security chief Alexander Lebed met Toby Gati, U.S. assistant secretary of state for intelligence, in Moscow on Friday and explained Russia's opposition to NATO's expansion eastwards, Interfax news agency said.
Lebed, secretary of Russia's Security Council and a potential successor to President Boris Yeltsin, visited NATO headquarters in Brussels earlier this week.
Gati asked about the settlement of the Chechen conflict, which Lebed negotiated in August, and planned Russian army reforms and sought Lebed's evaluation of events in Afghanistan.
U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry will visit Moscow next week to discuss closer military ties and urge parliament to approve the Start-2 strategic arms reduction treaty.
